record.dic_text:
06017 `Amorah {am-o-raw'}

源自 06014; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Gomorrah 19; 19

蛾摩拉 = "浸沒"
1) 與所多瑪同為邪惡之城, 皆因上帝的審判而被從天而來的火所毀滅
   1a) 用於指邪惡 (比喻用法)
record.edic_text:
06017 `Amorah {am-o-raw'}

from 06014;; n pr loc

AV - Gomorrah 19; 19

Gomorrah = "submersion"
1) the twin-city in evil with Sodom, both destroyed in judgment by
   God with fire from heaven
   1a) of iniquity (fig.)
